'''Proteam Omega''' (Japanese: '''タウリナー{{tt|Ω|オメガ}}''' ''Tauriner Omega''), known as '''Taurina Omega''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is a {{wp|mecha}} anime directed by the [[Radio Director]] that {{adv|Diamond}} and {{adv|Silver}} are huge fans of in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga series. The anime is the reason why Diamond works so hard to prevent [[Cyrus]] from accomplishing his goals of creating an emotionless world.

==Character==
[[File:Proteam Omega Formation Adventures.png|thumb|right|Proteam Omega's formation]]
Proteam Omega is a giant robot that defends the world. When a crisis occurs, Commander {{p|Venusaur}} calls his team:
* {{p|Pikachu}} controls '''Tauri-Plane''' (Japanese: '''タウリプレーン'''), a biplane;
* {{p|Poliwrath}} controls '''Tauri-Liner''' (Japanese: '''タウリライナー'''), a train;
* {{p|Gyarados}} controls '''Tauri-Ship''' (Japanese: '''タウリシップ'''), a boat;
* {{p|Aerodactyl}} controls '''Tauri-Balloon''' (Japanese: '''タウリバルーン'''), a hot air balloon;
* {{p|Snorlax}} controls '''Tauri-Rescue''' (Japanese: '''タウリレスキュー'''), a fire truck.
When all five unite their vehicles, Proteam Omega is formed. Its antagonist is '''Demon Brioche''' (Japanese: '''デモニッシュ デニッシュ''' ''Demonish Danish''), known as Devilish Dennis in the Chuang Yi translation.

==History==
====Prior to the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}} and the {{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}====
Proteam Omega's origins were revealed in ''[[PS460|All About Arceus IX]]''. The Radio Director, having witnessed the training of Red and {{adv|Gold}} in [[Mt. Silver]], was inspired and decided to direct a show based on {{cat|Red's Pokémon}} team. Initially, Gold was peeved because the director did not adhere to his team as well and demanded that the director put his team in the show as well. Silver became addicted to the show and frequently used the TV in Gold's house to watch it.

===={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}====
Proteam Omega first appeared in ''[[PS339|A Bevy of Bidoof]]'', where Diamond is seen watching it and singing its theme song. In ''[[PS345|Robust Rotom]]'', Diamond and Pearl spot two mysterious figures while going through the [[Eterna Forest]]. When they go inside the [[Old Chateau]] and are attacked by a {{TP|Diamond|Rotom}}, who is hiding in a television, Diamond uses the figures he saw earlier to find the hidden Rotom, as the mysterious figures he saw were the villains from an episode of Proteam Omega.

Diamond brings up Proteam Omega when the {{DL|Celestic Town|Celestic Ruins}} are attacked by Cyrus in ''[[PS369|Problematic Probopass and Mad Magnezone II]]'', where he compares [[Team Galactic]] to Proteam Omega's enemy, the Demon Brioche, and its minions.

In ''[[PS391|Luring in a Lickilicky]]'', when Diamond fights a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Lickilicky}}, he finds out that it was trying to protect a pile of stolen objects, including a Proteam Omega toy. In the [[PS392|next chapter]], Diamond attempts to return all of the items his newly-{{pkmn2|caught}} Lickilicky, [[Kit]], had stolen. When he goes to return the Proteam Omega toy, he finds out that it was thrown away by the child who previously owned it, thus allowing him to keep it for himself. He decides to play with his newly acquired toy, but it runs off with Diamond chasing after it, eventually leading him to {{adv|Platinum}}'s house.

When infiltrating the Galactic shuttle, Diamond reveals that he always thought that people as evil as the Proteam Omega villains were made up and had no chance of existing in reality. However, during his adventures, he was shocked to find out that such villains really exist, and swears that he cannot allow such evil to exist.

===={{MangaArc|Platinum}}====
In ''[[PS441|The Final Dimensional Duel XI]]'', Rotom infuses itself with a Proteam Omega toy in order to take and destroy [[Charon]]'s Pokémon controlling device, after which it promptly shocks the Team Galactic {{tc|Commander}} into submission.

==Trivia==
* The live-action puppets used in Proteam Omega's show represent {{adv|Red}}'s {{cat|Red's Pokémon|Pokémon}}, while Demon Brioche represents a {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}.
* Proteam Omega, along with several other shows similar to it, is named after a [[Vitamin]], followed by a Greek letter. In the case of Proteam Omega, it is named after the [[Protein]] (Japanese: '''タウリン''' ''Taurine'').
*** In ''[[PS460|All About Arceus IX]]'', {{adv|Silver}} is seen watching '''Proteam Hexa Σ''' (Japanese: '''ブロムヘキサー{{tt|Σ|シグマ}}''' ''Bromhexer Sigma''), which is named after the [[Iron]] (Japanese: '''ブロムヘキシン''' ''Bromhexine''). This series is also mentioned in ''[[PS345|Robust Rotom]]'' by {{adv|Diamond}} as '''Iron Hexer Sigma''' as a saga of Proteam Omega.
** In ''[[PS466|An Odd Speech]]'', a list of [[Gigi]]'s filmography was shown. In it, she was noted to have acted in the live action version of '''Calcium Man: The Movie''' (Japanese: '''リゾチウマー{{tt|α|アルファ}}''' ''Lysozymer Alpha''), which is named after the [[Calcium]] (Japanese: '''リゾチウム''' ''Lysozyme'').
